takes.line: Okay, do not fall for this fan. This thing is a scam.
First, Spin 360 claims it can recreate that soft outdoor breeze…
Then I found out it pulls air in from the top and the bottom…
It feels completely different. The air around— the air around the bed…
Then there's the sound. At the lower speeds, it's ridiculously quiet…
At this point, I'm getting irritated because… scent pods.
And within a few minutes, my room goes from…a very put-together man…
Which brings me to the actual scam, calling Spin 360 a fan…
So seriously, do not fall for it…Honestly, very misleading.
